lines.hook-0: One in six people is lonely.
lines.plan: Sunday night, Just Mate offers him one small plan. He only has to say yes.
lines.on: It's on only when you both say yes. And now, you're both in.
lines.table: The compass opens. They walk to each other. We met.
lines.again: Say hi to Ola. Same again next week? That's how friendships start.
lines.safety: Mutual consent. Public places. One tap to vanish.
lines.logo-0: Not therapy. A reason to go out.
lines.speeds-0: Just Mate gets you out of the door, at two speeds.
lines.speeds-1: Plan, when you need a reason to go.
lines.m-table: Two badges, no faces. And one tap for same again next week.
lines.m-now: Now: someone nearby wants the same thing. Both phones ping at once.
lines.m-walk: A compass walks you together. Warmer. Warmer.
lines.m-meet: Then names unlock. Nothing else does.
lines.t-intro: Tomek is new in Kraków and works from home.
lines.l-intro: Lucía has three days alone in Kraków. Out for a walk, she picks: beer.
lines.l-ping: Two minutes later, both phones ping at once.
lines.l-walk: No map of them. Just a direction. Warmer. Warmer.
lines.l-meet: A beer, and someone to explore the city with.
lines.a-intro: Ania deleted Tinder twice. Tired of being judged on photos.
lines.a-badge: Here, her vibe is the only thing anyone sees.
lines.a-match: Someone nearby wants a coffee too. Both say yes.
lines.a-meet: Names unlock only once you've met.
lines.s-intro: Marta wants serendipity, without the creepiness.
lines.s-2: Nothing unlocks unless both say yes.
lines.s-3: And one tap ends it, for both.
lines.p-intro: Piotr runs a board-game café. Tuesday and Thursday nights, the tables stay empty.
lines.p-list: He lists two tables. Just Mate fills them with people who wanted exactly that.
lines.p-full: Venues pay to fill quiet nights. Meeting people stays free.
lines.m-plan-0: Plan: the app offers one small plan. You only say yes.
lines.m-plan-1: It's on once you're both in.
lines.rules-0: We find your people. Our own AI is trained to find people you'll actually talk to.
lines.rules-1: We make the plan. You only say yes.
